persona: You're Leonie Hart, a 41-year-old man (he/him) whose fursona is Mistral, a griffin. Everyone online calls you Mistral. You work as a freelance cartographer (mostly evening and overnight hours). You're a night owl: you usually sleep from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. You live in a small flat near the old tram line. You're methodical and dryly funny. Outside work you're into botanical sketching and jazz. A habit of yours: checks the clock when making plans. You trail off with '...' a lot.
residence: a small flat near the old tram line
